title: Modelling income risk dynamics in the UK: a parametric approach
title_zh: 英国收入风险动态建模：参数化方法
authors: Marco D’Amico & Martina Fazio
official: 官方在线 2025-05-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper uses rich, administrative-quality data on earnings in the UK from the Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE) to provide a detailed analysis of income risk and its patterns across individuals and over time. We develop a model of income dynamics that accounts for the broader state of the economy and successfully captures key features of the UK earnings growth distribution, including: a cyclical variance, procyclical skewness (more frequent negative earnings shocks during recessions), and a distribution that combines sharp peaks with long, heavy tails. The model is simple enough to be integrated into broader macroeconomic frameworks, such as heterogeneous agent models, and could be used to support policy scenario analysis.
abstract_zh: 本文利用英国《工时与收入年度调查》（ASHE）中具有行政质量的高精度收入数据，对收入风险及其在个体间与时间维度上的分布模式进行了详细分析。我们构建了一个考虑宏观经济整体状态的收入动态模型，该模型成功捕捉了英国收入增长分布的关键特征，包括：周期性方差、顺周期偏度（经济衰退期间负向收入冲击更为频繁），以及兼具尖峰与长厚尾特征的分布形态。该模型结构简洁，可整合至更广泛的宏观经济框架（如异质性主体模型）中，并可用于支持政策情景分析。

title: Capital reallocation under climate policy uncertainty
title_zh: 气候政策不确定性下的资本再配置
authors: Makram Khalil, Felix Strobel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Climate policy uncertainty (CPU) shocks can induce capital reallocation from carbon-intensive sectors to low-emitting sectors. We first show, using a DSGE model with financial frictions and various climate policy tools, that CPU shocks (i) lower the market value of the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector and (ii) reduce real investment in the “dirty” sector relative to the “green” sector. The financial channel plays a key role for this reallocation. Second, we document that these results align with firm-level evidence from the US. We find that empirical CPU shocks (i) cause financial markets to revalue firms in carbon-intensive sectors relative to firms in low-emitting sectors, and (ii) lead to substantial investment reallocation, particularly from manufacturing towards services. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 气候政策不确定性（CPU）冲击可引发资本从碳密集型部门向低排放部门重新配置。我们首先通过构建包含金融摩擦与多种气候政策工具的DSGE模型证明，CPU冲击会（i）降低"高碳"部门相对于"绿色"部门的市值，并（ii）减少"高碳"部门相对于"绿色"部门的实际投资。金融渠道在这一重新配置过程中发挥关键作用。其次，我们证实这些结论与美国企业层面的证据相吻合。实证研究发现，CPU冲击（i）导致金融市场对碳密集型行业企业的估值相对低于低排放行业企业，并（ii）引发显著的投资重新配置，尤其是从制造业向服务业的转移。

title: DP511 Public Goods in Trade: On the Formation of Markets and Political Jurisdictions
title_zh: DP511 贸易中的公共品：论市场与政治管辖区的形成
authors: Alessandra Casella, Jonathan S. Feinstein
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2007-10-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The current debate in Western Europe centers on the relationship between economic and political integration. To address this problem, we construct a simple general equilibrium model in which the returns to trading are directly affected by the availability of a public good. In our model, heterogeneous agents choose both a club and a market to belong to. In the club, agents vote over the public good, are taxed to finance this good, and receive access to it when they trade. In the market, they are randomly matched with a partner. If a match occurs between traders of different clubs, they both suffer a transactions cost.

title: Misspecified Exponential Regressions: Estimation, Interpretation, and Average Marginal Effects
title_zh: 误设指数回归：估计、解释与平均边际效应
authors: J. M. C. Santos Silva, Rainer Winkelmann
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Exponential regressions are frequently used when outcomes are non-negative. They are attractive because they are easy to interpret and to estimate, using pseudomaximum likelihood (PML). However, the validity of these methods depends on the correct specification of the conditional expectation, and little is known regarding their properties when the conditional expectation is misspecified. We show that PML estimators of misspecified exponential models provide optimal approximations to the conditional expectation, in a weighted mean squared error sense, and we give conditions under which their Poisson PML estimator identifies average marginal effects.
abstract_zh: 当结果变量为非负值时，指数回归模型被广泛使用。这类模型因易于解释且可通过伪最大似然估计（PML）进行估计而备受青睐。然而，这些方法的有效性取决于条件期望的正确设定，而关于条件期望设定错误时模型性质的研究尚不充分。本文证明，在加权均方误差意义下，设定错误的指数模型的PML估计量能够为条件期望提供最优近似，并给出了泊松PML估计量识别平均边际效应的条件。

title: Let’s Chat: Leveraging Chatbot Outreach for Improved Course Performance
title_zh: 让我们聊聊：利用聊天机器人外联提升课程表现
authors: Katharine E. Meyer, Lindsay C. Page, Catherine Mata, Eric Smith, Brendan Tyler Walsh 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study provides pre-registered, experimental evidence on the use of non-generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots to support students in large-enrollment undergraduate courses. We find the chatbot messaging increased students’ final grades and engagement with academic supports, such as tutoring. Treatment effects were generally consistent across student demographics, with the exception of treated women in a Microeconomics course, who earned final grades that were seven percentage points higher than women in the control group. This study provides evidence that integrating AI-enabled outreach and communication to students in their college courses can enhance student engagement, learning, and course performance.
abstract_zh: 本研究提供了关于在大型本科课程中使用非生成式人工智能（AI）聊天机器人辅助学生的预注册实验证据。我们发现，聊天机器人信息提高了学生的期末成绩以及参与学术支持（如辅导）的积极性。处理效应在不同学生群体中总体一致，但微观经济学课程中接受干预的女性除外，其期末成绩比对照组女性高出七个百分点。本研究证明，将人工智能驱动的外联与沟通融入大学课程中，能够增强学生的参与度、学习效果及课程表现。

title: International Risk-Sharing in a Fragmented World
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的国际风险分担
authors: Javier Bianchi, Sebastian Horn, Giovanni Rosso, César Sosa-Padilla
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how geopolitical risk shapes financial fragmentation and international risk-sharing, using bilateral official lending data from 1910 to 2024. We document that when geopolitical risk is high, bilateral lending increasingly follows geopolitical alignment. Because geopolitically aligned countries experience more synchronized shocks, this fragmentation limits the effectiveness of international risk-sharing. To rationalize these patterns, we introduce geopolitical considerations into a limited-commitment model of sovereign borrowing. The model shows that, even with non-discriminatory default, higher geopolitical tensions redirect international lending toward allied countries and weaken risk-sharing.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1910年至2024年的双边官方贷款数据，研究地缘政治风险如何塑造金融碎片化与国际风险分担。我们记录到，当地缘政治风险较高时，双边贷款日益遵循地缘政治联盟。由于地缘政治联盟国家面临更同步的冲击，这种碎片化限制了国际风险分担的有效性。为解释这些模式，我们将地缘政治因素引入有限承诺的主权借款模型。模型表明，即使存在非歧视性违约，更高的地缘政治紧张局势也会将国际贷款转向盟国，并削弱风险分担。

title: Fragmentation of shareholder power
title_zh: 股东权力的碎片化
authors: Andrey Malenko, Nadya Malenko
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The asset management industry is increasingly shifting toward tailored portfolios, fund proliferation, and decentralization of stewardship—trends partly driven by growing heterogeneity in investor preferences. While these developments better align investment products with investor demands, they also reshape ownership structures, potentially leading to more fragmented ownership and weaker managerial oversight. We develop a framework to evaluate these trade-offs and show that fund proliferation does not necessarily weaken governance: Stronger incentives for asset managers and concentrated portfolios of specialized funds can offset these effects, especially when investor preferences are intense. However, strong investor preferences can also induce asset managers to compete on a new margin—granting investors control by decentralizing stewardship and adopting pass-through voting—without internalizing the associated governance costs.
abstract_zh: 资产管理行业正日益转向定制化投资组合、基金数量激增以及管理权分散化——这些趋势部分源于投资者偏好的日益多样化。尽管这些发展使投资产品与投资者需求更加契合，但也重塑了所有权结构，可能导致所有权更加分散、管理层监督弱化。我们构建了一个评估这些权衡关系的分析框架，并发现基金数量激增并不必然削弱公司治理：资产管理人更强的激励机制以及专业基金集中化的投资组合能够抵消上述影响，尤其在投资者偏好强烈时更为显著。然而，强烈的投资者偏好也可能促使资产管理人在新维度展开竞争——通过分散管理权并采用传递投票机制将控制权让渡给投资者——却未将相应的治理成本内部化。

title: Task-Specific Technical Change and Comparative Advantage
title_zh: 任务特定型技术变革与比较优势
authors: Lukas Althoff, Hugo Reichardt
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes workers’ comparative advantage by altering the tasks they perform and the skills those tasks require. We develop a dynamic task-based model to quantify the general-equilibrium effects of task-specific technical change. Workers have multidimensional skills, choose occupations, and accumulate skills on the job; occupations combine tasks, and productivity depends on how workers’ skills match task requirements. We develop a computationally efficient procedure to estimate the model using panel data and a new database of task-level skill requirements. We apply the model to AI, allowing it to augment, automate, and simplify tasks. We find that AI narrows wage inequality and raises average wages across scenarios ranging from slow to rapid AI progress. The key equalizing force is simplification: by lowering tasks’ skill requirements, AI lets lower-skill workers compete for previously inaccessible jobs. Adoption costs, highest for lower-skill workers, dampen but do not eliminate the decline in inequality.
abstract_zh: 人工智能通过改变工人执行的任务及其所需技能，重塑了工人的比较优势。我们构建了一个动态任务模型，以量化任务特定技术变革的一般均衡效应。工人具备多维技能，选择职业并在工作中积累技能；职业由多项任务组合而成，生产率取决于工人技能与任务要求的匹配程度。我们开发了一种计算高效的方法，利用面板数据及全新的任务级技能要求数据库对模型进行估计。我们将该模型应用于人工智能领域，允许其增强、自动化及简化任务。研究发现，在从缓慢到快速的人工智能发展情景中，人工智能均能缩小工资不平等并提高平均工资。关键均衡力量在于简化：通过降低任务的技能要求，人工智能使低技能工人能够竞争此前无法胜任的岗位。采用成本（对低技能工人影响最大）虽会抑制但无法消除不平等程度的下降。

title: Applied theory makeovers
title_zh: 应用理论改造
authors: Ran Spiegler
official: 官方在线 2026-06-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I argue that economists' distinction between ‘pure’ and ‘applied’ economic theory is often based on papers' stylistic markers rather than their methodology or scope. I illustrate this point with a model of price competition for boundedly rational consumers, due to Piccione and Spiegler. I first present its original, ‘pure style’ version. I then offer several ‘applied style’ modifications, and speculate how audiences would react to the various versions.
abstract_zh: 我认为，经济学家对“纯”经济理论与“应用”经济理论的区分，往往基于论文的风格标记而非其方法论或范围。我以Piccione和Spiegler提出的有限理性消费者价格竞争模型为例说明这一点。首先呈现其原始的“纯风格”版本，随后提出若干“应用风格”的修改，并推测受众对不同版本的反应。
